publisher: 独立行政法人情報処理推進機構（IPA）
observation: IPA's trade-secret management 2024 survey polled 1200 selected enterprise security/risk/IT/management respondents during January 23-31 2025. March 27 2026 chart-series corrections noted. The landing page reports survey details but does not give this app's security incidents or customer preference.
page_or_section: 調査概要、調査期間、調査数、更新履歴
limitations: The 1200 are purposive occupational respondents; not all Japanese firms. Report PDFs not analyzed yet.

publisher: 一般財団法人日本情報経済社会推進協会（JIPDEC）・ITR
observation: January 16-20 2026 proprietary online panel: 1107 individuals, one respondent per company, employees at Japan companies with >=50 workers and managerial/IT-risk/administrative roles. JIPDEC analysis reports 36% of respondents' companies actively using AI in defined three activity categories; not all firms. Respondents reporting governance priorities include human review/source explanation (35.3%).
page_or_section: 調査概要、AIの活用状況と課題
limitations: Nonprobability panel restricted to company size and occupational roles; 36% not interchangeable with previous white-paper measure 86.4% on 'any AI use'.

publisher: 株式会社エイトレッド／ワークフロー総研（IDEATECH実査）
observation: Of 110 selected DX/backoffice workers, 84 reported active AI use (76.4%). Among the 84 users, 56/84 (66.7%) found prompting for desired results difficult, and 41/84 (48.8%) reported AI output verification time burden. These are reported workplace difficulties, NOT direct measured preference for no-input slide software.
limitations: Commercial sponsor, role-restricted panel, small self-selected sample; question requires multiple answers. 56/84 and 41/84 reflect rounded percentage inversion, not observed microdata.

publisher: 東京大学教育・情報担当理事等
observation: University of Tokyo's dated 2023 preliminary course-use policy grants course staff authority over AI use, prohibits direct AI-written answers submitted as own work, requires human correction and copyright/data caution. It does NOT set the requirements of other universities nor establish current 2026 AI data retention conditions.
page_or_section: 授業における利用について 項目1-8
limitations: Document explicitly preliminary as of 2023; current course rules and privacy terms may have changed. No student opinion or AI slide outcomes measured.
